caption:
I tripped on the stairs

i tripped on the stairs. everyone saw. (nobody was there)

For whoever is still thinking about that one time.

The theory: the spotlight effect, we think others notice our slips far more than they do (Gilovich, Medvec and Savitsky, 2000, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology). An example, not a diagnosis.

#Cella

Closer to yourself.

alt: A short film with no voice. A coral room with a cream staircase on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks to the steps and trips on the first one, eyes wide. It looks left, right, up and at the camera. The room is empty. Then it pulses once with happy eyes. The text stays: i tripped on the stairs, everyone saw, (nobody was there).
